# proxmox_qemu_agent_file (Data Source)

Reads a guest file through the agent at `/nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/agent/file-read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_qemu_agent_file" "f" {
  node = "pve-1"
  vmid = 300
  file = "/etc/hostname"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `decode` (Boolean) Base64-decode the content.
- `offset` (Number)
- `read_count` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `content` (String)
- `truncated` (Boolean)
